subject.title: feat(repair): dispatch durable cluster jobs exactly once

question: Should the state materializer be approved to hold a scoped GitHub App token that dispatches repair-worker workflows as part of the durable cluster-intake design?
rationale: The proposed reliability architecture intentionally introduces an `actions: write` credential and new durable recovery semantics; the code can constrain the mechanism, but maintainers must choose whether this operational trust boundary is acceptable for ClawSweeper.

options.title: Approve the bounded dispatch boundary
options.body: Review the full stacked contract and accept the scoped token after confirming the materializer is the intended sole dispatcher.

options.title: Require a narrower dispatch mechanism
options.body: Keep the durable ledger design but require a different trusted dispatcher or additional authorization boundary before landing the workflow changes.

options.title: Pause the reliability stack
options.body: Defer this internal automation expansion if the operational complexity and workflow-write capability are not currently warranted.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded dispatch boundary
recommendation.body: Review the full stacked contract and accept the scoped token after confirming the materializer is the intended sole dispatcher.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the demonstrated contributor across the interdependent cluster-intake layers and can explain the intended credential and recovery contract.
